overview: A student management system where admins create subjects and multiple-choice questions, students take quizzes by subject, and admins evaluate student scores with per-answer correct/incorrect breakdowns.
features: Admin and student login via Internet Identity
Admin creates subjects including programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Go, etc.)
Admin adds multiple-choice questions per subject
Students take quizzes grouped by subject
Admin views student scores and evaluates individual answers
Per-answer correct/incorrect visual indicator in admin results
